opportunities.name: arXiv paper lookup → Semantic Scholar citations → note
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced for a topic in a specific year, open the top result, look up that paper on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, and save a summary note.
steps: Open arXiv Search > Advanced search
Enter search term
Tick date filter, select specific year, enter YYYY
Click Search and open the top result
Copy the paper title
Search the title on Semantic Scholar and open the result
Read the first author and citation count
Add a note: '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <n> citations'

opportunities.name: Case law lookup → statute lookup → note
opportunities.description: Search a court case on CourtListener, open it, look up a related US Code section on Cornell LII, and save a note with citation, decision date and statute.
steps: On CourtListener go to Case Law > Search Case Law
Enter case name and press Enter
Open the matching case result
Note the citation and decision date
On Cornell LII search the related US Code section and open it
Add a note: '<case>: <cite>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)'

opportunities.name: Peerspace venue search
opportunities.description: Search Peerspace for venues by activity and city, choosing the autocomplete option and clicking Search (often repeatedly to review results).
steps: Click the activity field, select all, type the activity
Click the location field, select all, type the city
Choose the matching autocomplete option
Click Search

opportunities.name: 1800flowers product search
opportunities.description: Search 1800flowers for a flower type and open a product.
steps: Click the Search box, select all
Type the flower query and press Enter
Open the desired product link
